verdict.rationale:
Snowflake's SQL engine and platform are built for set-based bulk operations (COPY INTO via Snowpipe for bulk file loads, streams tracking bulk DML changes, warehouses that resize to handle large bulk workloads), and the CLI/MCP surfaces let an AI-native user or agent drive these bulk SQL/DML operations headlessly (scripted `snow sql` with piped queries, MCP server exposing SQL execution as a tool). This gives genuine bulk-operation capability accessible to automated/AI workflows.
missing for 10: an explicit documented example of an AI agent issuing a single bulk operation across many discrete items (e.g., a batch API endpoint or agent-specific bulk-update tool) rather than inferring it from general SQL bulk-load/DML features.
